messages:
alex (primary): evening handoff — ongoing multi-alert for embeddings path in eu-west (INC-4721). paging history: two P1 pages in last 40m. current customer impact: increased latency for embeddings-only routes (not completions) and occasional 5xxs for the bulk-embed job. Affected tenants: tenant-a-prod (high), tenant-b-prod (medium).

alex (primary): symptoms — p95 embed latency ~820ms, p99 ~1.7s; errors ~3% across the embed queue. KV cache eviction rate spiked at 00:12 UTC to 95% eviction ratio. Memory pressure on node pool "embed-eu-1" looks correlated w/ prefetch spikes and a recent rollout of quantized-worker v2.1.

incident-bot: [alert] INC-4721 triggered: embeddings.p99.latency > 1500ms (rule: embeddings_p99_eu_west).

mira (secondary): I picked this up 25m ago after the second pager. Summary of mitigations done so far:
- rolled back quantized-worker v2.1 -> v2.0 on embed-eu-1 (rollback ID: rb-2740001). deploy-bot confirms rollback applied to 4/6 pods.
- increased per-pod KV cache size from 4GB -> 6GB on embed-eu-1 as a temporary knob.
- disabled prefetch for low-priority tenants by flipping feature flag ff/embeddings/prefetch -> off for group low.
- applied soft throttle to bulk-embed queue (rate reduce 40%).

jon (runtime): note — rollback restored kernel fallback for some requests but we still see tail evictions because the background prefetcher was overloading cache. Need to verify kv-cache compaction behaviour.

alex (primary): logs and commands i ran (paste):
```
# checked eviction metrics
kubectl -n inference top pod embed-eu-1-0
curl -s http://metrics.internal/embeddings/evictions?node=embed-eu-1 | jq .
# rollback
deploy-bot rollback --service quantized-worker --to v2.0 --selector region=eu-west
```
kubectl output showed memory at ~82% on 3 pods, 94% on the 1 problematic pod.

sara-cs: customer comms — notified tenant-a-prod about degraded embeddings and potential retries. They're seeing delayed semantic search results; asked them to enable fallback embeddings to our hosted fallback for urgent queries (they accepted). Logged a support ticket with tenant-a-prod case #CS-9982.

deploy-bot: rollback complete for quantized-worker -> v2.0 on pods {embed-eu-1-0, embed-eu-1-1, embed-eu-1-2, embed-eu-1-3}. 2 pods on eu-west still on v2.1 due to constraint (rolling update paused).

ops-bot: scheduled a rolling restart job for embed-eu-1-4 at 01:10 UTC (non-disruptive attempt).

mira (secondary): outstanding alerts to track:
- Grafana alert: embeddings.p95.eu-west > 700ms (firing)
- Cloudwatch: node.evictions.embed-eu-1 > 50/min (firing)
- Queue length: bulk-embed-queue > 120 (warning)

jon (runtime): deeper notes — heap dumps show frequent GC pauses and a KV cache compaction bug in v2.1 (we've seen similar in canary tests but lower frequency). Root cause hypothesis: v2.1 changed how hot keys are pinned; combined with aggressive prefetch, we get oscillation -> evictions -> prefetch reload -> more evictions.

alex (primary): temporary playbook actions (done):
- rollback quantized-worker v2.1 -> v2.0 (see deploy-bot)
- disabled prefetch for low-priority tenants
- throttled bulk-embed producer by 40%
- increased per-pod cache allocation (temporary)
- started rolling restart on the most-evicting pod

alex (primary): next actions (for next shift):
- monitor embeddings.p95/p99 and node.evictions for next 2h. If evictions persist > 30/min after above, escalate to runtime lead (jon) for emergency hotfix.
- coordinate with infra to repro on staging using a prefetch load generator (ticket INFRA-5599).
- confirm the two remaining pods on v2.1 are drained/rolled back. If they fail, optional: move traffic off node pool and rebuild.
- keep CS in loop for tenant-a's mitigation; offer migration to hosted fallback if problems persist.

mira (secondary): operational checklist for whoever takes next shift:
1) Check /alerts in the runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/embeddings-eviction (runbook has quick commands and thresholds).
2) Watch these panels: Grafana -> "Embeddings EU-West" (p95, p99, eviction-rate, cache-occupancy).
3) Run these queries if needed:
```
# eviction timeseries last 30m
GET /api/metrics?query=evictions.total{region=\"eu-west\"}&window=30m
# current pod image versions
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=quantized-worker -o wide
```
4) If eviction > 50/min and p99 > 1500ms after 30m, call runtime on-call (jon) and prepare to toggle global prefetch off: `feature-toggle set ff/embeddings/prefetch false --scope global`
5) If bulk-embed queue doesn't drop after throttling, scale consumer pool by +2 and watch memory.

jon (runtime): longer term action item I filed: INF-7742 — root cause triage for v2.1 cache compaction race and prefetch interaction. Assigned to runtime/kv. Not a hot rollback candidate across all regions yet; need staging repro.

alex (primary): handoff summary for whoever takes over: primary=alex until 01:00 UTC, secondary=mira until 01:00 UTC. After 01:00 UTC, mira will be primary and tag @next-oncall to pick secondary. Current SLO risk level = elevated (customer-visible latency + support tickets).

mira (secondary): exit note before stepping off: i've left watch on grafana alert, restarted two pods, confirmed tenant-a fallback enabled. If anything spikes, page me on pagerduty (PD: #oncall-embeddings).

incident-bot: [note] 3 pages were sent to oncall between 00:05-00:40 UTC.

alex (primary): ok handing off now — last checked metrics at 00:31 UTC. Good luck — please escalate if you see eviction storm reappear. :wave:
